`hollow-box.result.json` is the casting worker's own `result.json` (worker 0.16.0, schema 1) for `hollow-box.step`, a synthetic sample written by the worker's `make-samples` (a 100 x 60 x 40 mm box with a closed 60 x 20 x 20 mm void: one core). It is a real worker output, never a customer file, so it can be committed. Regenerate with the worker image:
`docker run --rm --entrypoint make-samples casting-worker:check /out`, then `casting-worker:check /in/hollow-box.step /out`.
